items.title: Monotone single-source algebraic branching programs are closed without changing their format
items.author: Markus Bläser; Christian Ikenmeyer; Meena Mahajan; Anurag Pandey; Nitin Saurabh
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete24-page CCBY3.0Unported publication; originalTheorem3/fullSection4 proof with exactLaurent-positive approximation andformat conditions.
items.difficulty_reason: After standard negative-power transport, the proof repeatedly eliminates an epsilon factor by exploiting monotonicity to force every source-sink path across an epsilon-edge, then rescales the epsilon-free reachable region from its leaves so that division at the source preserves the graph format and nonnegative limiting computation.
